project_metadata.description: DIA window optimization for Fusion Lumos with 70% satisfaction target

input_data._comment_current_cycle_time: Current cycle time in seconds (e.g., 1.5). If null, auto-estimated from gradient length. Used for Stage 2 DPPP diagnosis.
input_data._comment_enable_replicate_consensus: Enable technical replicate consensus handling. Auto-detects multiple runs from Run column.
input_data._comment_min_replicates: Minimum number of replicates to keep (default: 1 includes singletons).
input_data._comment_max_intensity_cv_percent: Maximum intensity (Precursor.Quantity) geometric CV% threshold for filtering (default: 30). Singletons always kept. Standard proteomics QC metric.
input_data._comment_column_selection: Column selection is AUTOMATIC (no configuration needed). Always keeps: Precursor.Id, RT.Start, Precursor.Mz, FWHM, Protein.Group + QC columns (if present). Typical memory savings: ~80% (e.g., 40 columns → 5-10 columns)

rt_binning._comment_rt_binning_mode: RT binning mode: 'fixed' (equal-width) or 'adaptive' (KS change-point detection)

window_generation._comment_width_grid_step: Grid step for width digitization in Da (default: 0.5). Snaps variable window widths to nearest multiple for batch reproducibility. Set to null or 0 to disable. Only applies to density (variable) mode.
